correctness.rationale: Euler-class additivity gives the exact subcategory; semisimplicity gives the cohomology-plus-contractible decomposition and Ext formula; exponent-e repetitions supply admissible test objects and explicit special ideal approximations; two stalk-pair witnesses rule out special object approximations. The idempotent-completion statement follows because every ambient object is a summand of its e-fold direct sum.

originality.rationale: To the best of our knowledge, Ren--Wang give the modulus-two vector-space case, while targeted searches found no theorem extending the construction to arbitrary nonzero finite quotients of K0 of a Hom-finite semisimple category. Classical K0-based dense-subcategory results are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the structural mechanism hidden by parity, yields examples for every modulus and simultaneous higher-rank congruences, and explains why the signed Euler class rather than unsigned total cohomology is the correct extension-stable higher-modulus invariant.
